packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch and minor devDependency updates after CI passes
Group Biome packages (toolchain moves in lockstep)

TypeScript is declared twice. The peerDependency range stays >=5.0.0 <7 — consumers choose their own compiler within the majors whose main entry exposes the JS compiler API (TypeScript 7 moved transpileModule under unstable/*, and the transpile loader refuses an API-less module with one diagnostic), and that is the contract this rule protects; do not bump it. The devDependency is separately caret-pinned in package.json to the major the suite is actually verified against: an unbounded >=5.0.0 there meant `npm outdated` resolved `wanted` two majors ahead, so a fresh install or a lockFileMaintenance refresh could land a new TypeScript major unreviewed. This rule keeps Renovate off both; a major adoption is a deliberate, reviewed change.

The complexity metric core behind the CRAP/maintainability gates. These packages compute every score, so a bump changes committed baselines and must only happen via a deliberate baseline recut — never an automated bump. All are terminal abandonware (pure-JS, CVE-free); babel-runtime is declared because the metric core requires it without declaring it. See docs/roadmap.md (Part 1, 'Also parked').

@babel/parser is the complexity kernel's parser front-end. The kernel's fixed plugin list does not parse under 8.x — several names became default syntax and the parser throws on them — so a major bump breaks every score. Minor and patch bumps are fine. Adopting 8.x is a deliberate change with a baseline recut attached; see .agents/scripts/lib/escomplex-kernel.js.
Do not touch the Node engines constraint; it is hand-managed

markdownlint-cli2 is COUPLED to the tree-wide `overrides.js-yaml` pin in package.json (see the `//` note there). npm applies an override ahead of a transitive package's own pin, and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.x declares an exact `js-yaml` 5.2.1 — a dry-run bump resolved 0.23.1 against js-yaml 4.3.0, two majors off, silently. The override cannot simply be dropped either: it is what keeps GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m (high) out of the tree. So exclude markdownlint-cli2 from the devDependency patch/minor auto-merge rule above — the override and the bump must land together in one commit, under human review.

DEFERRED — review by 2026-10-31. ajv-formats is effectively unmaintained upstream but is a load-bearing runtime dependency shipped in .agents/runtime-deps.json: it supplies the `date-time`/`uri` format assertions every schema validator in .agents/scripts/ relies on. It has no known vulnerability today (`npm audit` clean), so removal is deferred rather than forced — replacing it means re-authoring format assertions across every shipped schema. Updates stay ENABLED so a security release is never blocked, but auto-merge is off so each bump — and the deferral itself — gets a human look. At the review date, re-decide: adopt a maintained replacement, inline the small surface, or extend the deferral with a fresh date. (string-argv shared this deferral until its only importer, lint-baseline.js, was retired and the dependency dropped.)
Major updates always need manual review
GitHub Actions: group all workflow action bumps into one PR
